schema:
CREATE TABLE "EMPLOYEES" ("EMP_ID" INTEGER, "DEPT_ID" INTEGER, "IS_FULL_TIME" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY ("EMP_ID"));
CREATE TABLE "PROJECTS" ("PROJ_ID" INTEGER, "DEPT_ID" INTEGER, "STATUS" VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY ("PROJ_ID"));
correct_query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN IS_FULL_TIME = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(EMP_ID) FROM EMPLOYEES WHERE DEPT_ID IN ( SELECT DEPT_ID FROM PROJECTS WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE' )
